# Cincinnati State

> Cincinnati State is a community college offering associate degrees, certificates, and pathways to four-year degrees with multiple campuses and employer partnerships.

Cincinnati State serves prospective and current students across Clifton, Middletown, and Harrison campuses with comprehensive academic, career, and student support services. The institution maintains strategic partnerships with major employers like Amazon and GE Aviation while supporting student success through advising, tutoring, and cooperative education programs.

## Admissions & Prospective Students

- [Home - Cincinnati State](https://www.cincinnatistate.edu): Cincinnati State homepage offering degrees, certificates, and pathways to four-year degrees
- [Future Students - Cincinnati State](https://www.cincinnatistate.edu/future-students): Prospective student information on admissions, degrees, and career programs across multiple campuses
- [Campus Visit - Cincinnati State](https://www.cincinnatistate.edu/visit): Campus tour scheduling and information sessions across Clifton, Middletown, and Harrison campuses
- [Parents - Cincinnati State](https://www.cincinnatistate.edu/parents): Parent resources for supporting student success and understanding FERPA regulations

## Academic Services & Registration

- [Registrar - Cincinnati State](https://www.cincinnatistate.edu/registrar): Registrar services including class registration, transcripts, and FERPA compliance
- [Academic Advising - Cincinnati State](https://www.cincinnatistate.edu/academic-advising): Academic advising services, scheduling, and degree requirements using MyCstate and Starfish
- [Course Catalog - Cincinnati State Self-Service](https://selfservice.cincinnatistate.edu/Student/Courses): Course catalog and search tool through Cincinnati State student portal
- [Important Dates - Cincinnati State](https://www.cincinnatistate.edu/academic-calendar): Academic calendar with registration deadlines, financial aid dates, and semester schedules
- [Transcripts - Cincinnati State](https://www.cincinnatistate.edu/registrar/transcripts): Official and unofficial transcript ordering through National Student Clearinghouse

## Financial Planning & Costs

- [Tuition and Fees - Cincinnati State](https://www.cincinnatistate.edu/tuition-fees): Tuition rates, fee schedules, and cost of attendance for in-state and out-of-state students

## Student Support & Success

- [Support - Cincinnati State](https://www.cincinnatistate.edu/support): Student support resources including tutoring, counseling, disability services, and food pantry
- [Career Center - Cincinnati State](https://www.cincinnatistate.edu/career-center): Career services, job search resources, and employer partnerships at Clifton Campus
- [Starfish - Cincinnati State](https://www.cincinnatistate.edu/starfish): Starfish retention platform guide for academic advising and appointment scheduling

## Community & Partnerships

- [Partners - Cincinnati State](https://www.cincinnatistate.edu/partners): Cincinnati State partnerships with Amazon, GE Aviation, and other major employers
- [Alumni - Cincinnati State](https://www.cincinnatistate.edu/alumni): Alumni community engagement, association membership, and networking opportunities

## Support & Giving

- [Give - Cincinnati State](https://www.cincinnatistate.edu/give): Donation and fundraising opportunities through Cincinnati State Foundation
